dependence_unit.reason: Minutes, contracts, decisions, fills, and trades within a session share market state, account state, causal occupancy, and opportunity state.
forbidden_pseudoreplication: treating model seeds as market samples
treating action heads as market samples

required_values: each matched-random schedule serial PnL cents
entry intents, fills, failed fills, WAIT, PENDING, OCCUPIED, SOFT_CLOSED, and DAILY_STOPPED counts
minimum equity, maximum drawdown, daily-stop and ruin state
required_session_ledger.no_trade_session: retained with zero PnL and zero contribution where defined

corrected_effective_sample_size.name: Geyer initial-positive-sequence long-run-variance estimator
corrected_effective_sample_size.ordered_series: finite paired session statistics in chronological order
corrected_effective_sample_size.paired_sums: Gamma_m=gamma_(2m)+gamma_(2m+1) for every complete pair with 2m+1<=n-1
initial_positive_sequence: Starting at m=0, retain consecutive Gamma_m while Gamma_m is strictly positive; stop before the first nonpositive pair.
Replace each retained Gamma_m after the first with min(previous_adjusted_Gamma, current_Gamma) to enforce the initial monotone sequence.
Do not stop merely because one individual autocorrelation is nonpositive.
corrected_effective_sample_size.zero_variance: If every session value is exactly equal, use the degenerate-case rules; do not fabricate an ESS.
corrected_effective_sample_size.pooled_rule: Estimate ESS in each fold and sum fold ESS values; never estimate autocovariance across fold boundaries.
corrected_effective_sample_size.use: MDE and sufficiency diagnostic; intervals and p-values come from the block bootstrap.

within_fold_algorithm: For block length L and a fold with n>=L ordered sessions, legal block starts are integers 0 through n-L.
Sample ceil(n/L) legal starts uniformly with replacement.
Append each contiguous block [start,start+L) without wrapping.
Truncate the concatenation to n sessions.
moving_block_bootstrap.pooled: For each replicate and L, resample each fold independently, preserve each fold's raw session count, then concatenate folds.
moving_block_bootstrap.synchronization: For a fixed replicate, L, and fold, reuse the exact resampled session indices across every registered candidate, seed, metric, comparator, fee path, sensitivity convention, and control.

seed_derivation.integer: Interpret the first 16 hexadecimal digits as an unsigned integer and reduce modulo 2^32.

conservative_sensitivity_envelope.adjusted_lower_bound: minimum adjusted lower bound across L in {3,5,8}
conservative_sensitivity_envelope.adjusted_upper_bound: maximum adjusted upper bound across L in {3,5,8}
conservative_sensitivity_envelope.adjusted_one_sided_p: maximum adjusted p-value across L in {3,5,8}
conservative_sensitivity_envelope.pass: A hard condition passes only when the conservative envelope passes.

studentized_maxT.scope: Every active statistic identity in the current ordered multiplicity family.
studentized_maxT.standard_error: For each hypothesis h and block length L, use the standard deviation of its synchronized uncentered bootstrap replicate means; zero or nonfinite standard error follows degenerate rules.
studentized_maxT.centered_null_resample: Subtract observed_mean_h from every session value for hypothesis h, apply synchronized block indices, and divide the centered resample mean by SE_h_star.

lower_bound_construction.critical_value: empirical nearest-rank 0.95 quantile of max_lower over 20,000 replicates

upper_bound_construction.critical_value: empirical nearest-rank 0.95 quantile of max_upper over 20,000 replicates
upper_bound_construction.purpose: Mechanically decide sufficiently negative/harmful or no-signal cases using a simultaneous upper bound matched to the lower-bound family.

studentized_maxT.nearest_rank_quantile: For B sorted values and q, take one-based index ceil(q*B), with no interpolation.
studentized_maxT.two_sided_descriptive: Report unadjusted percentile [0.025,0.975] intervals; hard terminal decisions use the simultaneous one-sided lower and upper bounds.
studentized_maxT.candidate_conjunction: A candidate passes a conjunctive gate only if every required contrast passes under the conservative block-length envelope.

statistic_specific_MDE.fold_seed_metric_regime: Use the same statistic's corrected ESS, marginal session SD, multiplicity count, and frozen boundary; never borrow pooled precision or another metric's MDE.

fold_shapes: five independent folds of 45 sessions pooled without cross-fold blocks

checks: coverage of each one-sided 95% lower bound at the true mu
coverage of each one-sided 95% upper bound at the true mu
coverage of the conservative block-length envelope
no generated block crosses or wraps a fold boundary
the ESS estimator does not truncate at an isolated nonpositive autocorrelation
synthetic_AR_coverage_demonstration.pass_rule: For every phi, mu, fold shape, block length, and bound direction, empirical coverage is at least 0.93 and the Wilson 95% lower confidence limit for coverage is at least 0.90; the conservative envelope must also satisfy both conditions.
synthetic_AR_coverage_demonstration.failure: invalid_inference_implementation; no market evidence may be evaluated
synthetic_AR_coverage_demonstration.artifact: synthetic_ar_coverage_receipt.json with code hash, fixture identities, coverage table, and pass/fail

phase_F_shadow_intervals.resampling: For each L in {3,5,8}, apply the same noncircular within-phase chronological block bootstrap to complete sessions; each selected session contributes all of its paired decisions as an indivisible cluster.
phase_F_shadow_intervals.point_statistic: sum agreement numerators across selected session clusters divided by sum denominators across those clusters
phase_F_shadow_intervals.hard_lower_bound: minimum one-sided 95% lower bound across block lengths
phase_F_shadow_intervals.hard_upper_bound: maximum one-sided 95% upper bound across block lengths

all_session_deltas_exactly_zero.exact_no_harm_route: passes only the zero-margin no-harm component; it proves no superiority

independent_reproduction.inputs: hashed decision and session source ledgers, never copied producer summaries
